title: Analista de Dados Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Coletar e limpar dados, identificando fontes relevantes e tratando valores ausentes e outliers;
  • Aplicar conceitos e ferramentas de digital analytics: GA4, firebase, GTM, Big Query;
  • Desenvolver dashboards, queries, algorítmos para monitorar e melhorar a performance dos processos;
  • Ser propritário de sua frente de negócio, planejando e priorizando as atividades de acordo com as necessidades de negócio e do valor de suas entregas para Allos;
  • Traduzir problemas de negócios em termos analíticos e facilitar tomadas de decisão para resolução destes problemas;
  • Propor pró-ativamente soluções técnicas e de negócio;
  • Ser pró-ativo na garantia de segurança e privacidade dos dados, cumprindo regulamentações.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em tecnologia, ciências exatas/biológicas com foco em tecnologia ou experiência comprovada na área de banco de dados;
  • Experiência em Data Analytics, Big Query/Databricks;
  • Conhecimento Avançado em análise de dados e estatística intermediário (Amostragem, Teste de Hipótese, Inferência).
  • SQL (DQL, DDL) Avançado.;
  • Conhecimento Intermediário linguagens como JavaScript, Python ou R. Experiencia em extração de dados, ingestão e transformação;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Tableau, Power BI).


Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Transporte/Estacionamento;

title: Senior Data Scientist / ML Engineer
description:
Project Description:

The primary goal of the project is the modernization, maintenance and development of an eCommerce platform for a big US-based retail company, serving millions of omnichannel customers each week.

Solutions are delivered by several Product Teams focused on different domains - Customer, Loyalty, Search and Browse, Data Integration, Cart.

Current overriding priorities are new brands onboarding, re-architecture, database migrations, migration of microservices to a unified cloud-native solution without any disruption to business.


Responsibilities:

  • We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer with Machine Learning expertise and good understanding of search engines, to work on the following:
  • - Design, develop, and optimize semantic and vector-based search solutions leveraging Lucene/Solr and modern embeddings.
  • - Apply machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing techniques to improve search relevance and ranking.
  • - Develop scalable data pipelines and APIs for indexing, retrieval, and model inference.
  • - Integrate ML models and search capabilities into production systems.
  • - Evaluate, fine-tune, and monitor search performance metrics.
  • - Collaborate with software engineers, data engineers, and product teams to translate business needs into technical implementations.
  • - Stay current with advancements in search technologies, LLMs, and semantic retrieval frameworks.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Science or Machine Learning Engineering, with a focus on Information Retrieval or Semantic Search.
  • Strong programming experience in both Java and Python (production-level code, not just prototyping).
  • Deep knowledge of Lucene, Apache Solr, or Elasticsearch (indexing, query tuning, analyzers, scoring models).
  • Experience with Vector Databases, Embeddings, and Semantic Search techniques.
  • Strong understanding of NLP techniques (tokenization, embeddings, transformers, etc.).
  • Experience deploying and maintaining ML/search systems in production.
  • Solid understanding of software engineering best practices (CI/CD, testing, version control, code review).


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: UX Conversacional – Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 55997



Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera em UX Conversacional, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência comprovada em design conversacional, abrangendo o desenvolvimento de chatbots, URA e jornadas no WhatsApp, incluindo a criação de fluxos conversacionais, scripts e personas.
  • Conhecimento avançado em mapeamento de jornadas do usuário, elaboração de blueprints de serviço e diagramas de fluxo de alta complexidade, utilizando ferramentas e metodologias reconhecidas pelo mercado.
  • Vivência na definição de estratégias e requisitos de tagueamento (instrumentação) para mensuração de métricas de experiência do usuário (UX) e indicadores de negócio, tais como Drop-off Rate, Taxa de Sucesso e CSAT conversacional.
  • Proficiência no uso de ferramentas de prototipação (por exemplo, Figma, Miro ou similares), incluindo experiência na condução de testes de usabilidade, testes A/B e análise heurística em canais conversacionais.
  • Familiaridade com as capacidades e limitações das principais plataformas de construção de chatbots e APIs de WhatsApp Business.
  • Competência para realizar pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas em UX Research, incluindo entrevistas, análise de logs de conversação e pesquisas de satisfação.
  • Experiência em ambientes ágeis, com atuação em squads (Scrum/Kanban) e colaboração direta com Product Owners (PO) e equipes de engenharia.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: UX Conversacional – Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 55997



Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera em UX Conversacional, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência comprovada em design conversacional, abrangendo o desenvolvimento de chatbots, URA e jornadas no WhatsApp, incluindo a criação de fluxos conversacionais, scripts e personas.
  • Conhecimento avançado em mapeamento de jornadas do usuário, elaboração de blueprints de serviço e diagramas de fluxo de alta complexidade, utilizando ferramentas e metodologias reconhecidas pelo mercado.
  • Vivência na definição de estratégias e requisitos de tagueamento (instrumentação) para mensuração de métricas de experiência do usuário (UX) e indicadores de negócio, tais como Drop-off Rate, Taxa de Sucesso e CSAT conversacional.
  • Proficiência no uso de ferramentas de prototipação (por exemplo, Figma, Miro ou similares), incluindo experiência na condução de testes de usabilidade, testes A/B e análise heurística em canais conversacionais.
  • Familiaridade com as capacidades e limitações das principais plataformas de construção de chatbots e APIs de WhatsApp Business.
  • Competência para realizar pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas em UX Research, incluindo entrevistas, análise de logs de conversação e pesquisas de satisfação.
  • Experiência em ambientes ágeis, com atuação em squads (Scrum/Kanban) e colaboração direta com Product Owners (PO) e equipes de engenharia.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Analista de Dados Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Coletar e limpar dados, identificando fontes relevantes e tratando valores ausentes e outliers;
  • Aplicar conceitos e ferramentas de digital analytics: GA4, firebase, GTM, Big Query;
  • Desenvolver dashboards, queries, algorítmos para monitorar e melhorar a performance dos processos;
  • Ser propritário de sua frente de negócio, planejando e priorizando as atividades de acordo com as necessidades de negócio e do valor de suas entregas para Allos;
  • Traduzir problemas de negócios em termos analíticos e facilitar tomadas de decisão para resolução destes problemas;
  • Propor pró-ativamente soluções técnicas e de negócio;
  • Ser pró-ativo na garantia de segurança e privacidade dos dados, cumprindo regulamentações.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em tecnologia, ciências exatas/biológicas com foco em tecnologia ou experiência comprovada na área de banco de dados;
  • Experiência em Data Analytics, Big Query/Databricks;
  • Conhecimento Avançado em análise de dados e estatística intermediário (Amostragem, Teste de Hipótese, Inferência).
  • SQL (DQL, DDL) Avançado.;
  • Conhecimento Intermediário linguagens como JavaScript, Python ou R. Experiencia em extração de dados, ingestão e transformação;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Tableau, Power BI).


Nossos benefícios:

title: Senior React Native Developer
description:
Salary Open to negotitate based on experience, Competitive! (payment in USD)

(Full time position, independent contractor.)


StaffingAbroad is seeking a highly skilled Frontend Developer to join one of the #1 Fintech & Crypto companies in the United States . This is a unique opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and build world-class applications in a dynamic, innovative environment.

This position is offered as a 100% remote role.


About the Role

As a Frontend Developer, your primary skillset will be React Native , with additional strong experience in React being highly desirable. You’ll play a critical role in designing and delivering highly polished, pixel-perfect applications that provide exceptional user experiences. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and backend developers, to bring complex financial and crypto-related solutions to life.


What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software design, or related field of study, or equivalent experience.
  • 6+ years' experience building production-grade web or mobile applications with a strong focus on UI excellence.
  • English C1 (MUST)
  • Deep expertise with React Native (primary skill).
  • Strong experience with React (highly desirable), including hooks, context, and performance optimization.
  • Strong TypeScript experience.
  • Expert-level CSS skills with proficiency in Tailwind and styled-components .
  • Proven track record of delivering pixel-perfect, highly polished user interfaces .
  • Experience building and maintaining reusable component libraries .
  • Experience with complex form implementations and client-state management .
  • Solid foundation in software development best practices.
  • Familiarity with software quality practices such as unit testing, mocking, integration testing, and code coverage.
  • Experience using source control (Git) .
  • Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies .
  • Bilingual English (conversational level required) .
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Enthusiasm for working in a fast-paced, innovative environment and alignment with company culture and values.

Plus

  • Familiarity with Continuous Integration (CI/CD) pipelines (TeamCity, Azure DevOps).


Why Join?

  • 100% Remote –
  • Join a team that is shaping the future of #1 Fintech and Crypto in the U.S.

title: Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 47748
description:
Role Overview:

We’re seeking detail-oriented candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. You’ll read, summarize, and analyze complex content, validate claims through online research, and collaborate with Large Language Models (LLMs) to improve their performance.


Your work will directly contribute to refining cutting-edge AI systems (like Gemini) — no prior AI experience required — a great opportunity to build expertise in the growing field of AI.


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • You will be assisting with screening and training the others need to be Google account users (uses some combination of Gmail, YouTube, Gemini, Search, Photos) willing to use their personal accounts for this eval (can redact any personal information they are not willing to share)


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • No AI experience required.
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: Availability of up to 40 hours per week is preferred
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract: 2 Weeks initial pilot, could extend.
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los Angeles


About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Full Stack Mobile Developer
description:
About the Role  

I am supporting a US healthcare client in hiring a Full-Stack Mobile Developer to take end-to-end ownership of their flagship mobile application. In this role, you will serve as the sole mobile developer , responsible for evolving an app that pairs with a Bluetooth-enabled pulse oximeter ring to capture overnight sleep data and securely upload it to the cloud.


You won’t be working in isolation—while you’ll lead all mobile-focused design and development, you’ll collaborate closely with a team of experienced C#/.NET backend engineers. You’ll also contribute to backend features related to sleep-study processing and data workflows, helping shape the overall product experience from device integration through clinical-grade data analysis.


This is an opportunity to own a critical mobile product in a modern health-tech environment, working with senior engineers to deliver technology that directly impacts patient outcomes. The ideal candidate will have expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/.NET), and be capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services. 

Key Responsibilities  


  • Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android. 
  • Implement and optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device. 
  • Address Android battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection. 
  • Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 
  • Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted .NET services, contributing to backend development when required. 
  • Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards. 
  • Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team. 


Requirements  


  • Professional level English comprehension (spoken, reading/writing)
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in mobile development. 
  • Proven experience with Flutter/Dart  for cross-platform mobile applications. 
  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET , with the ability to contribute to backend services. 
  • Deep understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)  implementation. 
  • Experience with Android battery optimization techniques  for background processes. 
  • Successful track record of publishing and maintaining apps in the App Store and Google Play. 
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Azure services . 
  • Familiarity with Firebase  (Authentication, Crashlytics, Analytics), Sentry , and PostHog . 
  • Advanced English communication skills (C1 level ), both written and spoken. 
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. 
  • Prior experience in health or medical app development is a plus. 

Technical Skills  


  • Primary:  Flutter/Dart, Bluetooth LE, iOS, Android 
  • Secondary:  C#, .NET, Azure, Firebase 
  • Tools:  GitHub, Sentry, PostHog, App Store Connect, Google Play Console 


What We Offer  


  • The opportunity to develop innovative health technology with real impact. 
  • Competitive salary based on experience. 
  • Professional growth and development opportunities. 
  • A collaborative team culture that values independence and initiative.

title: Profissional Designer UX
description:
Código da vaga:55998


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


UX Designer será fundamental na otimização da jornada e experiência do cliente em nossos canais de comunicação automatizados, com foco em WhatsApp e Chatbot.

Experiência Design (Conversational UX/CUX: experiência no design de chatbots, URA e jornadas no WhatsApp, incluindo a criação de flows (fluxos), scripts e personas conversacionais.

Domínio em ferramentas e metodologias para mapear jornadas do usuário, blueprints de serviço e diagramas de fluxo de alta complexidade.

Tagueamento e Instrumentação de Dados (Analytics

Atuação em ferramentas Figma, Miro ou similar

Conhecimento de Plataformas de Chatbot/WhatsApp


CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP MM ,Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Must Have

Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, NFe knowledge and enhancements to supply processes specially with SAP DRC, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects. Experience with SAP DRC inbound.


Good to Have

Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC outbound.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.



As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requitements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Lead the end-to-end implementation of SAP DRC NF-e projects, including requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and deployment.

Customize and optimize SAP DRC solutions to ensure seamless electronic invoicing (NF-e) compliance in Brazil or other supported jurisdictions.

Ensure accurate integration of SAP DRC with external systems, including government tax portals and legacy systems.

Provide subject matter expertise on local tax regulations and compliance requirements for e-invoicing.

Identify risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies during the project lifecycle.

Conduct user training, support issue resolution, and provide go-live assistance.

Maintain documentation for processes, configurations, and project changes.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Experience in a Professional Consumers and packag

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Reimbursement of Certifications

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

Flex AI is looking for a highly creative, fast, and detail-oriented Video Editor & Creative Producer to help us produce engaging short-form content for TikTok, Instagram, and other social platforms.

  • Stay on top of current TikTok trends, formats, and editing styles

  • Strong proficiency in CapCut, Final Cut, Premiere, or similar
  • Good sense of pacing, storytelling, hooks, and visual rhythm
  • Ability to produce content quickly and consistently
  • Portfolio of UGC-style or TikTok-style videos required

  • Organized, self-directed, and comfortable with fast iteration

  • Motion graphics or text animation skills
  • Basic understanding of social performance metrics

  • Fully remote, flexible working environment
  • High-ownership creative role
  • Opportunity to work on a fast-growing consumer product
  • Consistent creative work with lots of room for experimentation
  • Competitive compensation based on experience

title: Senior Full Stack Javascript Developer
description:
About HotMic


HotMic builds AI-powered video creation workflows that help creators and media teams produce high-quality content faster and more efficiently. We operate our own platform and also work closely with large enterprise customers to deliver custom, high-impact solutions.


Role Overview


We are hiring a Senior Full Stack Javascript Developer to work directly with one major enterprise customer. This is a hands-on role involving both full-stack JavaScript development and customer-facing support. You will gather requirements, develop and ship customer-specific features, resolve issues, and keep the customer updated through calls and messages. You’ll also participate in our regular engineering sprints alongside other developers and product staff.


Responsibilities


  • Develop and deliver features tailored to a large enterprise customer.
  • Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
  • Communicate directly with the customer via calls and messages.
  • Work within engineering sprints and coordinate with internal teams.
  • Maintain clear, fluent English communication.


Requirements


  • Fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Senior-level full-stack JavaScript experience.
  • Experience working in structured team sprints.
  • Background working with enterprise customers or complex implementations.
  • Comfortable in a mixed engineering + support role.
  • Strong teamwork and ability to work independently.

title: Desenvolvedor Mobile
description:
Vaga: Desenvolvedor Mobile (Flutter)

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Mobile com experiência sólida em Flutter e integração com Android nativo , para atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de nossas aplicações.


Requisitos Técnicos

Linguagens/Frameworks

  • Domínio em Flutter (Dart);
  • Forte conhecimento em Programação Orientada a Objetos (POO);
  • Experiência com GetX (state management, rotas, injeção de dependência);
  • Experiência com MethodChannel para comunicação Flutter ↔ Android nativo;
  • Conhecimento sólido em Android Nativo (Java e/ou Kotlin);

Ferramentas

  • Experiência com VS Code;
  • Conhecimentos em Android Studio (build, emuladores, debugging nativo);
  • Uso de Git (Azure DevOps ou GitHub);

Plataforma/Arquitetura

  • Experiência com ciclo de vida de aplicações Flutter;
  • Estruturação modular de projetos;
  • Consumo de APIs REST;
  • Manipulação de armazenamento local (SharedPreferences, SQLite);
  • Integração com bibliotecas nativas Android via Gradle;
  • Criação e manutenção de bridges Flutter ↔ Android.

Qualidade/Performance

  • Familiaridade com testes unitários em Flutter;
  • Boas práticas de otimização de performance;
  • Tratamento de exceções e logs.


Diferenciais (Desejáveis)

  • Conhecimento em C# ou Node.js;
  • Experiência com integrações de pagamento, TEF, SmartPOS ou automação comercial;
  • Vivência com POS Android (Gertec, PAX, Sunmi, Stone, Cielo);
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD (Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions);
  • Boas práticas de segurança mobile;
  • Familiaridade com arquiteturas limpas (Clean Architecture, SOLID);
  • Experiência com criação e manutenção de plugins Flutter.


Benefícios

  • Horário flexível;
  • Banco de horas;
  • Auxílio home office;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Plano de cargos;
  • Auxílio especialização;
  • Folga no aniversário.


Se você preenche os requisitos e tem paixão por tecnologia e inovação, envie seu currículo para a IMEX e venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Full-Stack SaaS Web Developer
description:
Remote - full or part-time


Ego Eimi is building a global productivity ecosystem – software people actually love to use. We value agency, clarity, and adults who don’t need hand-holding.


We’re looking for a Full-Stack Web Developer with real SaaS product experience to help us build and improve web applications: dashboards, multi-tenant backends, and integrations that actually ship and get used.


This is a project-based, long-term collaboration. You’ll be a contractor paid per project, with scope and budget agreed upfront.


What you’ll do

You’ll own meaningful chunks of a modern SaaS app, end-to-end:

  • Design, build, and maintain web application features using:
  • Frontend: React / Next.js (App Router), modern JS/TypeScript
  • Backend: Node.js (Express / Next API routes / similar)
  • Implement core SaaS building blocks:
  • Authentication & authorization (e.g. Auth0, custom JWT)
  • Subscription billing (e.g. Stripe)
  • Multi-tenant or workspace-style architecture
  • CRUD dashboards, admin panels, settings pages
  • Work with PostgreSQL or similar via an ORM (e.g. Prisma, Supabase) for clean data models.
  • Integrate with external APIs (payment, AI, email, etc.) and design clean internal APIs.
  • Ensure performance, security, and reliability:
  • Basic testing (unit/integration), error handling, logging
  • Handling edge cases, validation, and safe deployments
  • Ship to production using common devops practices:
  • Git/GitHub workflows, pull requests, code reviews
  • Deployments to Vercel / AWS / similar
  • Communicate in writing: Short, clear async updates; Simple explanations of trade-offs and decisions.


Minimal meetings. Mostly async. We care that things ship and work.


You might be a great fit if you:

✅ Have 3+ years building production web applications (not just tutorials or toy projects).

✅ Have hands-on experience with React and/or Next.js for real products.

✅ Are comfortable with Node.js + TypeScript on the backend (REST or GraphQL APIs, background jobs, basic architecture).

✅ Have actually built features typical of SaaS:

  • User accounts, teams/workspaces, roles/permissions
  • Subscriptions, billing, Stripe webhooks
  • Dashboards, analytics views, settings pages

✅ Have shipped at least one SaaS MVP or product end-to-end or as a core contributor (bonus if B2B or productivity tools).

✅ Write clean, understandable code and are comfortable with Git workflows (branches, PRs, reviews).

✅ Are good at written English; you can explain what you’re doing and why.

✅ Are self-managing and proactive: you ask good questions early, surface risks, and propose options instead of waiting for instructions.


Nice-to-have (not required, but tell us if you have them):

  • Tailwind CSS / modern component libraries
  • Supabase / Prisma / tRPC
  • Experience with AI/LLM integrations (OpenAI / Anthropic)
  • Basic knowledge of security best practices for SaaS (authorization, data isolation, rate limiting, etc.)


We like working with people who:

  • Act like owners, not task-takers.
  • Care about users and UX, not just “getting something working”.
  • Prefer clarity and honesty over politics and drama.
  • Are comfortable saying “I don’t know yet, here’s how I’ll find out.”


How we work & how you get paid

  • Engagement type: project-based.
  • Payment model: fixed-price per project (decided per scope).
  • Project length: ideally long-term (6+ months).
  • Workload: you can take on more scope over time if you deliver reliably.
  • Communication: async by default; rare calls.
  • Location: worldwide, but you must be comfortable working with written async communication and version control.


If you want autonomy, hate micromanagement, and like being judged by the quality and reliability of what you ship, you’ll probably enjoy working with us.


How to apply

  • Apply through LinkedIn Easy Apply.
  • If we like your profile, we’ll reach out and ask for your portfolio (if you haven’t provided it yet) and a quick call.
  • If you do well in the call, you’ll get hired. Easy.


Hope to see you soon!

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely; able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Backend Developer CrewAI/Python
description:

O foco central da posição é a orquestração, integração e observabilidade de agentes CrewAI em um ecossistema corporativo global.


Modelo de atuação: Remoto

Conheça mais sobre a Mouts: mouts.info


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada com CrewAI .
  • Conhecimento em LLM APIs (OpenAI / Azure OpenAI).
  • Experiência sólida com Node.js e .NET .
  • Domínio no desenvolvimento de APIs REST .
  • Experiência em arquitetura de microsserviços .
  • Vivência com PostgreSQL e bancos vetoriais .
  • Experiência com CI/CD .
  • Atuação prévia em ambiente Azure .
  • Inglês básico a intermediário.


Responsabilidades Principais

  • Desenvolvimento de serviços backend para orquestração de agentes CrewAI.
  • Construção de integrações entre agentes e sistemas corporativos.
  • Implementação de pipelines de execução, estados e controle de agentes.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs REST para gestão e consumo de agentes.
  • Integração com mensageria (EventHub).
  • Implementação de mecanismos de logging, métricas e rastreabilidade.
  • Atuação conjunta com Arquitetura e DevOps em soluções Azure-native.
  • Garantia de qualidade, performance e segurança do ecossistema.
  • Desenvolvimento de testes automatizados.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com frameworks de agentes (LangGraph, Autogen, entre outros).
  • Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de observabilidade.
  • Vivência com Inteligência Artificial aplicada.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
As an AI Engineer at Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company), you will join a team of talented AI engineers to implement and deploy AI-driven solutions across various industries. You will be responsible for developing AI strategies, ensuring the successful execution of AI projects, and contribute to the development of AI tools and platforms. You will work closely with clients to understand their business needs, review and implement AI solution designs, and ensure that Acora remains at the forefront of AI innovation.


Key Responsibilities:

AI Solution Design & Development :

  • Join teams for development and implementation of AI solutions and systems for clients across various sectors.
  • Propose a broad spectrum of different ideas to complex problems, with the ability to quickly test and iterate to identify the best performing solution
  • Collaborate with Data Science, Cloud Engineering and UI designers and developers to design scalable, cloud-based AI architectures.
  • Stay ahead of the latest AI trends and technologies to continuously improve Acora’s AI offerings.

Client Engagement & Project Delivery :

  • Work with clients to understand their business challenges and objectives, translating them into AI-driven solutions.
  • Be a team player and help to ensure the timely and successful delivery of AI projects, maintaining high standards of quality, accuracy, and impact.
  • Be able to present AI strategies, solutions, and project outcomes to stakeholders, both technical and non-technical.
  • Nurture client relationships, whilst building credibility and trust through consistent high-quality delivery.

Operational Excellence :

  • Be part of the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of AI solutions, ensuring they perform reliably at scale.
  • Develop frameworks and processes to ensure AI models are robust, explainable, and aligned with regulatory standards.


Key Skills & Experience:

  • English is a MUST.
  • Proven experience in AI/ML engineer roles, ideally in consultancy or enterprise environments.
  • Strong expertise in AI/ML algorithms, tools, and frameworks (e.g., LangChain, MCP, Azure AI Foundry, PyTorch, Scikit-learn).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP) and cloud-native AI/ML architectures.
  • Understanding of AI/ML model lifecycle management, including explainability, ethics, and fairness in AI.
  • Basic stakeholder management and client-facing experience, with the ability to articulate complex AI concepts to business leaders.
  • Proficiency in Python, C#, Javascript.
  • Hands-on experience with big data technologies and distributed computing is a plus.


Why Join Elastacloud?

  • Innovative Environment : Work on groundbreaking AI projects that have a real-world impact on industries such as security, finance, and energy. We pride ourselves on innovating through play and games, providing a safe environment to test many ideas and fail fast.
  • Leadership Opportunity : Shape the direction of AI innovation at Elastacloud and make a lasting impact on the business.
  • Collaborative Culture : Join a passionate and driven team that thrives on collaboration and continuous learning.
  • Professional Growth : Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities, with the chance to stay at the cutting edge of AI and cloud technologies.

title: Profissional  Programador Golang
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?

Golang:

Domínio da linguagem, incluindo goroutines, channels, interfaces e padrões idiomáticos para desenvolvimento cloud-native.

Serverless (AWS Lambda):

Conhecimento em funções serverless, otimização de cold start e uso de runtimes customizados.

APIs:

Proficiência em design de APIs RESTful e WebSocket, integração com Lambda, throttling e caching.

AWS SDK for Go:

Conhecimento avançado do SDK oficial , incluindo session management, error handling e retry policies.

Containers (ECS / EKS):

Experiência em containerização de aplicações Go e orquestração serverless.

Banco de Dados:

Proficiência em bancos gerenciados RDS (PostgreSQL/MySQL), connection pooling, otimização de queries e NoSQL (DynamoDB).

Amazon S3:

Conhecimento em storage patterns, lifecycle policies e integração com aplicações Go.

Mensageria (Amazon SQS/SNS):

Proficiência em sistemas de mensageria, dead letter queues e fan-out patterns.

Infraestrutura como Código:

Terraform, CloudFormation ou ferramentas similares.

Observabilidade:

Experiência com Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch ou similares.


O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Virtual Assistant - Fully Remote

About the Job:

Join our team in a fully remote role with endless growth potential! We’re seeking a detail-oriented, organized professional with excellent English skills to support our dynamic team.

Your main role will be assisting with marketing activities for our agency and clients, alongside exciting tasks to build your skills. From managing warm leads via calls and SMS and booking appointments to designing in Canva and working with AI, funnels and automation, you’ll gain diverse hands-on experience. We’ll train you every step of the way!

Work Hours & Location:

  • Full-time role with a consistent 40-hour workweek and occasional overtime bonuses.
  • Work hours: 8:30am – 5.00pm New York Time (with a 30-minute break) Monday through Friday.
  • We’re hiring to work with US and Australian clients - bring your cultural awareness and global perspective!

Requirements:

description:
About You

You are a back-end engineer passionate about building scalable, reliable, and maintainable applications. title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Uitify


Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Full-Stack SaaS Web Developer
description:
Remote - full or part-time


Ego Eimi is building a global productivity ecosystem – software people actually love to use. We value agency, clarity, and adults who don’t need hand-holding.


We’re looking for a Full-Stack Web Developer with real SaaS product experience to help us build and improve web applications: dashboards, multi-tenant backends, and integrations that actually ship and get used.


This is a project-based, long-term collaboration. You’ll be a contractor paid per project, with scope and budget agreed upfront.


What you’ll do

You’ll own meaningful chunks of a modern SaaS app, end-to-end:

  • Design, build, and maintain web application features using:
  • Frontend: React / Next.js (App Router), modern JS/TypeScript
  • Backend: Node.js (Express / Next API routes / similar)
  • Implement core SaaS building blocks:
  • Authentication & authorization (e.g. Auth0, custom JWT)
  • Subscription billing (e.g. Stripe)
  • Multi-tenant or workspace-style architecture
  • CRUD dashboards, admin panels, settings pages
  • Work with PostgreSQL or similar via an ORM (e.g. Prisma, Supabase) for clean data models.
  • Integrate with external APIs (payment, AI, email, etc.) and design clean internal APIs.
  • Ensure performance, security, and reliability:
  • Basic testing (unit/integration), error handling, logging
  • Handling edge cases, validation, and safe deployments
  • Ship to production using common devops practices:
  • Git/GitHub workflows, pull requests, code reviews
  • Deployments to Vercel / AWS / similar
  • Communicate in writing: Short, clear async updates; Simple explanations of trade-offs and decisions.


Minimal meetings. Mostly async. We care that things ship and work.


You might be a great fit if you:

✅ Have 3+ years building production web applications (not just tutorials or toy projects).

✅ Have hands-on experience with React and/or Next.js for real products.

✅ Are comfortable with Node.js + TypeScript on the backend (REST or GraphQL APIs, background jobs, basic architecture).

✅ Have actually built features typical of SaaS:

  • User accounts, teams/workspaces, roles/permissions
  • Subscriptions, billing, Stripe webhooks
  • Dashboards, analytics views, settings pages

✅ Have shipped at least one SaaS MVP or product end-to-end or as a core contributor (bonus if B2B or productivity tools).

✅ Write clean, understandable code and are comfortable with Git workflows (branches, PRs, reviews).

✅ Are good at written English; you can explain what you’re doing and why.

✅ Are self-managing and proactive: you ask good questions early, surface risks, and propose options instead of waiting for instructions.


Nice-to-have (not required, but tell us if you have them):

  • Tailwind CSS / modern component libraries
  • Supabase / Prisma / tRPC
  • Experience with AI/LLM integrations (OpenAI / Anthropic)
  • Basic knowledge of security best practices for SaaS (authorization, data isolation, rate limiting, etc.)


We like working with people who:

  • Act like owners, not task-takers.
  • Care about users and UX, not just “getting something working”.
  • Prefer clarity and honesty over politics and drama.
  • Are comfortable saying “I don’t know yet, here’s how I’ll find out.”


How we work & how you get paid

  • Engagement type: project-based.
  • Payment model: fixed-price per project (decided per scope).
  • Project length: ideally long-term (6+ months).
  • Workload: you can take on more scope over time if you deliver reliably.
  • Communication: async by default; rare calls.
  • Location: worldwide, but you must be comfortable working with written async communication and version control.


If you want autonomy, hate micromanagement, and like being judged by the quality and reliability of what you ship, you’ll probably enjoy working with us.


How to apply

  • Apply through LinkedIn Easy Apply.
  • If we like your profile, we’ll reach out and ask for your portfolio (if you haven’t provided it yet) and a quick call.
  • If you do well in the call, you’ll get hired. Easy.


Hope to see you soon!

title: Administrative Analyst
description:
We are looking for an Operations Admin to support our Central Operations team and US Operations markets in general administrative tasks and onboarding growth. If you are a well organized, analytical person with exceptional communication and problem solving skills then this role may be for you!



What You’ll Focus On:

  • Support our US Operations Cities on growth deliverables and efficiencies in our day to day work and operations
  • Automations for our ways of working when it comes to growth and portfolio changes
  • Analyze data in order to create and prepare detailed reports for the leadership team that effectively communicate trends, patterns, and predictions using relevant data

title: Gerente de Produção
description:
Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Produção com experiência sólida em gestão industrial, responsável por liderar a produção, estruturar processos, garantir eficiência operacional e coordenar também o planejamento de produção (PCP). O profissional assegurará disciplina operacional, qualidade, produtividade, segurança e cumprimento de prazos.

Principais Responsabilidades

Gestão da Produção

• Gerenciar a rotina da produção, assegurando execução conforme plano, volume e qualidade.

• Acompanhar eficiência das linhas, indicadores, tempos, setups, paradas e produtividade.

• Implementar padrões operacionais, procedimentos e boas práticas de fábrica.

• Garantir o cumprimento das metas de produção e a estabilidade da operação.

Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP)

• Planejar e programar a produção de acordo com demanda, capacidade e estoques.

• Analisar e liberar ordens de produção, realizando o sequenciamento adequado.

• Controlar estoques de insumos e produtos acabados, monitorando lead times e previsibilidade.

• Gerenciar KPIs, acuracidade, aderência ao plano, setup, giro e disponibilidade de materiais.

Qualidade, Processos e Melhoria Contínua

• Garantir conformidade aos padrões de qualidade, normas internas e requisitos técnicos.

• Mapear processos, eliminar gargalos e estruturar melhorias contínuas (Lean, 5S, OEE).

• Trabalhar para aumento de eficiência, redução de custos e eliminação de desperdícios.

• Propor e implementar melhorias nos fluxos produtivos.

Gestão de Pessoas

• Liderar e desenvolver equipes de produção e PCP.

• Distribuir atividades, acompanhar performance e orientar tecnicamente a equipe.

• Conduzir feedbacks, treinamentos e gestão disciplinar.

• Fomentar ambiente de organização, alinhamento e foco em resultados.

Requisitos Técnicos

• Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Produção ou função equivalente.

• Domínio de PCP, processos industriais e indicadores de produção.

• Conhecimento em Lean Manufacturing, melhoria contínua e ferramentas de gestão.

• Vivência sólida em chão de fábrica e gestão de equipes.

• Experiência com ERP, controle de dados e Excel.

Perfil Profissional

• Liderança prática, com forte presença no chão de fábrica.

• Tomada de decisão rápida e baseada em dados.

• Organização, disciplina e orientação a resultados.

• Boa comunicação, postura firme e foco em processos.

Formação

• Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Industrial, Mecânica, Administração ou áreas correlatas.

• MBA/Pós em Gestão Industrial é um diferencial.

title: Visual Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Full professional proficiency in English is required for this position ⚠️

⚠️ Web Design challenge is going to be required ⚠️


Who we are


Uitify is a brand and growth partner for early-stage SaaS companies. We help ambitious startups define their positioning, design their identity, and communicate with clarity and personality — across every touchpoint. We combine strategy, design, and content to build brands that are consistent, memorable, and conversion-driven.

We work fast, collaborate closely, and care deeply about doing work that’s both smart and beautiful.


Who we’re looking for


We’re looking for a Visual Designer who brings strong visual direction, consistency, and creativity. You’ll work closely with our branding, marketing, and product teams to design clean, modern, and conversion-focused assets for fast-growing SaaS companies.

This is a hands-on creative role — ideal for someone who thrives on bringing ideas to life and shaping the visual expression of digital-first brands.


What you’ll do


  • Design and deliver high-quality visual assets: landing pages, pitch decks, social media creatives, eBooks, case studies, and more
  • Ensure consistency and alignment across all brand touchpoints
  • Collaborate with strategists, copywriters, and product designers to translate ideas into strong visuals
  • Contribute to branding, product, and marketing initiatives with a focus on performance and clarity
  • Present and discuss your work with the team and, occasionally, with clients


What we’re looking for


  • A strong portfolio showcasing digital design (branding, marketing, web, presentations, etc.)
  • 5+ years of experience;
  • Proficiency in Webflow, Figma or Framer, figma/canva/photoshop are differentials;
  • A sharp eye for layout, typography, hierarchy, and color
  • Experience designing for SaaS or B2B tech products
  • Ability to handle multiple projects with clarity, speed, and organization
  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail


Bonus points


  • Experience working with SaaS companies or startups
  • Experience with People Analytics or B.I.
  • Basic knowledge of UX principles and how design influences user behavior
  • Motion design or video editing skills
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently
  • A proactive, collaborative mindset and a passion for visual storytelling


Why Join Us?


At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply

title: Data & Analytics Specialist
description:
Remote - full or part-time


Ego Eimi is building a global productivity ecosystem – software people actually love to use. We value agency, clarity, and adults who don’t need hand-holding.


We’re looking for a Data & Analytics Specialist to turn messy, multi‑source data into clear dashboards and decision‑ready insights for us (and our clients). You’re a doer who can own the work end‑to‑end—from pulling the data to explaining what it means and what to do next.


This is a project‑based, long‑term collaboration (not a traditional full‑time job). You’ll be paid per project, with a monthly budget per project. If you’re efficient, you can handle 2–3 projects at once and increase your earnings accordingly.


What you’ll do

Own analytics delivery end‑to‑end for the projects you take on:

  • Translate business questions into analysis plans and measurable KPIs (north‑star metrics, guardrails, leading indicators).
  • Ingest & prep data from spreadsheets, product databases, marketing platforms (e.g., GA4, Meta/Google Ads export, CRM) via SQL/Python or native connectors.
  • Build reusable datasets (views, models, or lightweight ETL) and keep documentation tight (data dictionary, assumptions, freshness).
  • Ship dashboards and reports that decision‑makers actually use—Tableau/Power BI/Looker Studio preferred; Excel/Google Sheets when fastest.
  • Run funnel, cohort, and retention analyses; segment users; quantify drivers; and recommend actions.
  • Design and evaluate A/B tests or pre/post experiments when appropriate; interpret results carefully (power, MDE, significance, lift).
  • Create simple, written updates: what happened, why it matters, recommended next step.
  • Work async, manage your own time, and proactively flag data quality issues or opportunities.


No endless meetings. We just expect one message per workday: what you did yesterday, what you’ll do today, and any blockers.


You might be a great fit if you:

✅ Have hands‑on experience turning raw business data into dashboards and decisions (client or in‑house).

✅ Are fluent with SQL (joins, windows, CTEs), Excel/Sheets, and either Python (pandas) or a BI tool (Power BI / Tableau / Looker Studio).

✅ Can work with GA4/marketing exports or product data (events, tables, schemas).

✅ Are comfortable with cohort & retention, funnels, segmentation, and basic experimentation (t‑tests, nonparametric where needed).

✅ Can set up lightweight data pipelines (scheduled queries, dbt basics, or ELT in BigQuery/Snowflake/Redshift) when needed.

✅ Communicate clearly in writing: assumptions, caveats, and decision‑ready takeaways (not just charts).

✅ Share a public portfolio or anonymized examples showing: data sources, your approach, the artefacts (SQL, notebooks, dashboards), and business impact.


We like working with people who:

  • Act like owners, not task‑takers.
  • Care about decision quality, not vanity metrics.
  • Treat others with respect, honesty, and professionalism.


How we work & how you get paid

  • Engagement type: project‑based contractor/freelancer.
  • Payment model: per project, with a monthly budget agreed upfront.
  • Project length: usually longer than 1 month.
  • Workload: you can take on multiple projects (e.g., 2–3) depending on your efficiency and results.
  • Meetings: almost none. Communication is asynchronous, mostly in writing.


If you want autonomy, hate micromanagement, and enjoy being judged by your results, you’ll probably enjoy working with us.


How to apply

  • Apply through LinkedIn Easy Apply.
  • If we like your profile, we’ll reach out for your portfolio (if you haven’t provided it) and a quick call.
  • If you do well in the call, you’ll get hired. Easy.

title: Salesforce Developer | Mulesoft Experience
description:
We are seeking a Senior Salesforce Developer with strong development skills in both Salesforce and MuleSoft. This position will design, build, and maintain Salesforce applications while developing and managing MuleSoft APIs that connect Salesforce to core enterprise systems. 


Mission  


Deliver scalable, high-performance Salesforce solutions and integrations using MuleSoft and the Anypoint Platform, ensuring data consistency, reliability, and maintainability across systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


  • Design, develop, and deploy custom Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, and Salesforce DX. 
  • Build and manage MuleSoft APIs and flows (Mule 4) integrating Salesforce with ERP, HR, and financial systems. 
  • Apply API-led connectivity (System, Process, and Experience APIs) to create modular, reusable integration layers. 
  • Optimize Salesforce API usage, manage governor limits, and ensure data quality and consistency. 
  • Collaborate with architecture, DevOps, and QA teams to maintain CI/CD pipelines and enforce version control and testing best practices. 
  • Use DataWeave for data transformations and ensure strong performance and security in all Mule applications. 
  • Document integration patterns, API specifications, and system mappings. 
  • Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and production support. 


Required Skills and Experience  


  • 5–7+ years of hands-on Salesforce development (Apex, LWC, triggers, classes, Visualforce). 
  • 5–10+ years of overall software development experience in object-oriented programming (Java, C#, or similar). 
  • 3+ years of MuleSoft development, including API design and deployment using Anypoint Platform. 
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce APIs, REST/SOAP protocols, and integration design. 
  • Experience with CloudHub, Runtime Manager, API Manager, RAML/OAS, and CI/CD tools (Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab). 
  • Knowledge of Salesforce data models, SOQL/SOSL performance optimization, and security configuration. 
  • Strong English communication skills and experience working with distributed teams.

title: Lead Graphic & Motion Designer
description:
Graphic & Motion Designer Job Description

Location: Remote; ability to work in US EST time zone required

Type: Freelance, project-based


About BX Studio

BX Studio is one of the world’s leading Enterprise Webflow agencies—and the 2025 Webflow Enterprise Partner of the Year. We specialize in launching custom websites, ongoing website optimization, and digital branding.

We’re a remote-first team of ambitious, creative collaborators focused on delivering exceptional digital experiences for the world’s most forward-thinking brands.

We’ve partnered with Reddit, Headspace, NBC, and Verifone, spoken at Webflow Conf four times, and have been a trusted Webflow Enterprise Partner since 2020.


The Role

We’re building our pipeline of vetted creative partners for near-term and future collaborations. This role is ideal for designers interested in working with BX Studio on an ad hoc project basis as opportunities align.

We’re looking for a Graphic & Motion Designer to help bring SaaS and digital-first brands to life through compelling visual and motion storytelling. You’ll collaborate with senior designers and art directors to design product-driven graphics, animations, and illustrative elements that enhance websites, pitch materials, and brand systems.

This is a hands-on creative role focused on craft, consistency, and collaboration—you’ll be designing, animating, and refining visual assets that make complex ideas feel clear, cohesive, and engaging.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and animate graphics for SaaS interfaces, abstractions, data visualizations, and infographics that communicate product stories with clarity and impact.
  • Develop brand-aligned illustrations and visual systems that extend client assets across digital experiences.
  • Design brand and sales collateral including pitch decks, social graphics, reports, and client-facing documents for both digital and print applications.
  • Storyboard and concept short animations that demonstrate product value or explain key interactions.
  • Collaborate with UX, web, and motion leads to ensure visual consistency and seamless integration across site designs.
  • Support design and production of brand collateral, pitch decks, social graphics, and internal marketing materials.
  • Translate feedback from senior designers and clients into clear creative refinements.
  • Stay current on visual, animation, and data-driven design trends, bringing fresh ideas to the team.


What We’re Looking For

  • 2–4 years of experience in graphic or motion design , ideally within an agency or digital-product setting.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing UI abstractions, product graphics, data visualization, and motion design.
  • Experience working with B2B or SaaS brands a plus.
  • Proficiency in Figma, After Effects, Illustrator, and Photoshop (bonus: InDesign, PowerPoint, or light 3D).
  • Strong sense of composition, hierarchy, and animation timing.
  • Comfortable following established brand systems while contributing original ideas.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and reliable in meeting deadlines across multiple projects.
  • Enthusiasm for collaboration and openness to feedback from senior team members.


Why Join BX Studio?

  • Collaborate with award-winning designers and developers on world-class Webflow and brand projects.
  • Shape high-impact visual storytelling for leading B2B and consumer technology brands.
  • Join a remote-first, high-performing team that values craft, clarity, and creative rigor.
  • Contribute to an agency recognized as the 2025 Webflow Enterprise Partner of the Year, helping define the next evolution of web design.
